    A place in photographs

    Prayer, community, everyday work and sacred art. Open a photograph to see the full frame and read its story.

    Community photographs

    A peaceful corner in nature

    A pond, a small bridge and trees form a picturesque part of the grounds. This place recalls the beauty of God’s creation and the value of caring attentively for the world around us.

    A place for quiet prayer

    Among the greenery is a small place of prayer with a religious image. Such places invite a sense of quiet and spiritual attentiveness.

    A garden of quiet and spiritual peace

    Well-kept paths, conifers and the garden’s seasonal colours create a welcoming space where daily work meets quiet and prayer. Care for nature is part of the community’s responsible way of life.

    Care for God’s creation

    Domestic animals live alongside the garden and plants in the community grounds. Looking after them is another expression of everyday work and responsibility for the creation entrusted to us.
